description: Infos travaux - Liège is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Ce jeu de données représente les principaux chantiers menés par le service des travaux de la Ville de Liège ainsi que les travaux du Tram. Vu le grand nombre d’interventions en voirie entreprises par la Ville de Liège sur le réseau communal, il est impossible de vous en fournir une liste exhaustive. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are travaux, tram, Chantiers, mobilité. The portal shows 10 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
